entities.summary: Our Lady of Victory Church, also known as Wanghailou Church (望海楼教堂), is a Roman Catholic church located in Tianjin, China, which formerly served as the Cathedral church for the Tianjin diocese. It is one of the oldest churches in Tianjin.
